claim_scores.rationale: Defines an async `dspy.Module` with `aforward(question)` awaiting `self.predict.acall(...)` on a question-to-answer signature.
Configures `dspy` with offline `DummyLM` and builds a trainset of `dspy.Example(...).with_inputs("question")` items.
Creates `BootstrapFewShot` with a metric and the required demo limits `max_bootstrapped_demos=2` and `max_labeled_demos=0`.
Compiles `dspy.syncify(..., in_place=True)` with `trainset=dataset` and verifies the compiled predictor has exactly 2 demos.
Compiles `dspy.syncify(..., in_place=False)` with `trainset=dataset` and verifies the compiled predictor has exactly 2 demos.
